50.q: I ___ (must) finish this report tonight. (my own feeling)
50.explanation: Personal obligation, often from the speaker's own feeling, uses 'must'.

50.q: We ___ (be able to) solve the problem eventually.
50.explanation: A specific past achievement uses 'were able to'.

50.q: They ___ (must) be on vacation — their house looks empty.
50.explanation: Strong deduction based on evidence uses 'must'.

50.q: He ___ (must/leave) already — his car is gone.
50.explanation: Past modal of deduction: strong certainty about the past uses 'must have + past participle'.

50.q: She ___ (could) swim when she was five.
50.explanation: Past general ability uses 'could'.

50.q: ___ (can) I leave early today?
50.explanation: Informal permission uses 'can'.

50.q: He ___ (could) be the new manager; I'm not sure.
50.explanation: Possibility uses 'could'.

50.q: I ___ (can) speak three languages.
50.explanation: Present ability uses 'can'.

50.q: I ___ (must) call my mother tonight. (personal feeling)
50.explanation: Personal obligation uses 'must'.

50.q: He ___ (must) be tired — he's been working all day.
50.explanation: Strong logical deduction, near certainty, uses 'must'.
